//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
)

type earlyQFidInteractionEvidence struct {
	Early                                                    earlyWireEvidence
	QFid                                                     precisePolicyEvidence
	Exposed                                                  bool
	Outcome, Reason, SourceError, ProcessError, NativeOracle string
}

func earlyQFidProcessGuard(state earlyBootstrapState) error {
	if state.Error != "" {
		return errors.New(state.Error)
	}
	process := state.Process
	if process == nil || !process.ExitConfirmed || process.ExitCode != 0 || process.KillRequested || process.KillAttempted || process.KillReturned || process.OwnerRetained || process.Error != "" || process.WaitError != "" || process.KillError != "" || process.Outcome != "bootstrap_complete" {
		return errors.New("helper did not complete ordinary successful process ownership")
	}
	if process.Native == nil || !process.OutputComplete || len(process.Stderr) != 0 || process.InputBytes <= 0 || process.InputBytes > earlyBootstrapLimit || process.OutputBytes <= 0 || process.OutputBytes > earlyBootstrapLimit || process.OutputBytes != len(process.Stdout)+len(process.Stderr) {
		return errors.New("helper receipt or bounded output is incomplete")
	}
	if process.Started.IsZero() || process.Exited.Before(process.Started) || process.WaitReturned.IsZero() || process.WaitReturned.Before(process.Exited) || process.Exited.After(process.Started.Add(10*time.Second)) {
		return errors.New("helper exit was not confirmed inside the original bootstrap budget")
	}
	request := earlyBootstrapRequest{Nonce: process.Nonce, Root: state.UNC + `\`, ParentPID: process.ParentPID, Executable: process.Executable, ExecutableSHA256: process.ExecutableSHA256, Token: process.ParentToken}
	if process.Root != request.Root {
		return errors.New("helper root differs from the observed experimental share")
	}
	if err := earlyBootstrapRequestValid(request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var child earlyBootstrapChildReceipt
	if err := earlyBootstrapReadJSON(process.Stdout, &child); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := earlyBootstrapValidateChild(request, process.PID, child); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if child.Token != process.ChildToken || child.Native != *process.Native {
		return errors.New("retained helper facts disagree with its original output")
	}
	if child.Native.Flags != 0x406 || child.Native.MaximumComponentLength != 255 || child.Native.FilesystemName != "remote-fs" {
		return errors.New("helper did not observe the configured filesystem tuple")
	}
	return nil
}

func earlyQFidJoin(early *earlyWireRecord, identity *preciseIdentityRecord) bool {
	return early != nil && identity != nil && early.Response && identity.Response && early.Command == wire.Create && identity.Command == wire.Create && early.Status == 0 && identity.Status == 0 && early.Connection == identity.Connection && early.Session == identity.Session && early.Message == identity.MessageID && early.FileID != "" && early.FileID == identity.FileID
}

func earlyQFidInteractionGate(records []earlyWireRecord, identities []preciseIdentityRecord, parentWire []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, state earlyBootstrapState, report *parentInvalidationReport, sourceErr error) earlyQFidInteractionEvidence {
	result := earlyQFidInteractionEvidence{
		Early:   earlyWireGate(records, identities, state.UNC, state.Volume, state.Markers, report.Pending, true),
		QFid:    precisePolicyGate(preciseAlwaysQFid, identities, parentWire, report, state.Markers.FirstNewEnd),
		Outcome: "not_exposed", NativeOracle: report.IdentityResult,
	}
	if err := earlyQFidProcessGuard(state); err != nil {
		result.ProcessError = err.Error()
	}
	if sourceErr != nil {
		result.SourceError = sourceErr.Error()
		result.Outcome = "invalid_source"
		result.Reason = result.SourceError
		result.Early.Exposed = false
		result.Early.Outcome = "inconclusive"
		result.QFid.StimulusDelivered = false
		return result
	}
	if result.ProcessError != "" {
		result.Outcome = "process_failed"
		result.Reason = result.ProcessError
		return result
	}
	if !result.Early.Exposed {
		result.Reason = "early capability: " + result.Early.Reason
		return result
	}
	if !result.QFid.StimulusDelivered {
		result.Reason = "QFid: " + result.QFid.Error
		if result.QFid.Error == "" {
			result.Reason = "first CREATE did not deliver the required unrequested QFid"
		}
		return result
	}
	if !earlyQFidJoin(result.Early.HA, result.QFid.OldResponse) || !earlyQFidJoin(result.Early.Hnew, result.QFid.NewResponse) {
		result.Outcome = "invalid_join"
		result.Reason = "early and QFid evidence identify different HA or Hnew ownership"
		return result
	}
	if result.Early.HA.Tree != result.Early.Tree || result.Early.Hnew.Tree != result.Early.Tree || result.QFid.OldResponse.QFid == nil || result.QFid.NewResponse.QFid == nil || result.QFid.OldResponse.QFid.VolumeID != result.Early.VolumeSerial || result.QFid.NewResponse.QFid.VolumeID != result.Early.VolumeSerial {
		result.Outcome = "invalid_join"
		result.Reason = "QFid identities disagree with the independently bound tree volume"
		return result
	}
	request, response := result.QFid.NewRequest, result.QFid.NewResponse
	if request == nil || !(state.Markers.Mutation < state.Markers.FirstNewBegin && state.Markers.FirstNewBegin < request.Sequence && request.Sequence < response.Sequence && response.Sequence < state.Markers.FirstNewEnd) || result.Early.Hnew.Sequence >= state.Markers.FirstNewEnd {
		result.Outcome = "invalid_order"
		result.Reason = "new CREATE response was not observed inside the original first-open ordinal bracket"
		return result
	}
	result.Exposed = true
	result.Outcome = "joint_exposure"
	return result
}

func earlyQFidInteractionAudit(t *testing.T, report *parentInvalidationReport) {
	t.Helper()
	records, sourceErr := earlySnapshot()
	identities, identityErr := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
	sourceErr = errors.Join(sourceErr, identityErr)
	_, wireIncomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if wireIncomplete {
		sourceErr = errors.Join(sourceErr, errors.New("parent wire evidence is incomplete"))
	}
	earlyRegistry.Lock()
	state := earlyRegistry.state
	earlyRegistry.Unlock()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	state.Markers.Mutation = preciseIdentityRegistry.mutationSequence
	state.Markers.FirstNewEnd = preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	state.Markers.FirstNewBegin = report.FirstObservationSequence
	result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, report.Wire, state, report, sourceErr)
	if !result.Exposed {
		report.Classification = "inconclusive"
		report.WithinOneSecondProven = false
		t.Error("early QFid interaction qualification:", result.Reason)
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(struct {
		State       earlyBootstrapState
		Wire        []earlyWireRecord
		Identity    []preciseIdentityRecord
		Interaction earlyQFidInteractionEvidence
		Native      precisePolicyEvidence
	}{state, records, identities, result, precisePolicyNative(report)}, "", "  ")
	if err == nil {
		err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "early-qfid-interaction.json"), data, 0600)
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Error("write early QFid interaction evidence:", err)
	}
}

func TestNativeEarlyQFidInteraction(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("RFS_CAPABILITY_BOOTSTRAP") != "before-ha-qfid" || os.Getenv("RFS_PRECISE_VARIANT") != "historical_detail" || os.Getenv("RFS_QFID_POLICY") != preciseAlwaysQFid || os.Getenv("RFS_FILESYSTEM_CAPABILITY_POLICY") != preciseFilesystemPosix || os.Getenv("RFS_INTERACTION_POLICY") != preciseInteractionCombined {
		t.Fatal("early QFid interaction requires its exact explicit policy combination")
	}
	t.Run("share0_app_first_replace_identity_early_qfid", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		earlyReset()
		earlyActivate()
		t.Cleanup(earlyDeactivate)
		if err := preciseConfigureInteractionPolicy(preciseInteractionCombined, preciseFilesystemPosix, preciseAlwaysQFid); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		report := &parentInvalidationReport{Kind: "replacement", Name: "share0_app_first_replace_identity_early_qfid", ShareMode: 0, Order: "app_first"}
		parentRunCell(t, report.Name, report.Order, report.ShareMode, true, report)
		if report.RescanRequired || !report.PreciseNotificationProven {
			t.Error("early QFid interaction requires precise detailed notification")
		}
	})
}

func earlyQFidTestProcess(unc string) *earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt {
	raw := preciseTestFilesystemData(0x406)
	native := earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt{RootOpened: true, CloseAttempted: true, RootClosed: true, OpenAccess: 0x100080, OpenShare: 7, OpenFlags: 0x02000000, IOSBSize: 16, IOSBAlignment: 8, IOSBInformationOffset: 8, IOSBPresent: true, IOSBStatus: 0xc0000001, Information: uint64(len(raw)), RawBufferHex: hex.EncodeToString(raw), Flags: 0x406, MaximumComponentLength: 255, FilesystemName: "remote-fs"}
	token := earlyBootstrapToken{SID: "S-1-5-21-test", AuthenticationID: 12, SessionID: 1}
	request := earlyBootstrapRequest{Nonce: hex.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xab}, 32)), Root: unc + `\`, ParentPID: 100, Executable: filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "early-fixture.test.exe"), ExecutableSHA256: hex.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xcd}, 32)), Token: token}
	child := earlyBootstrapChildReceipt{Root: request.Root, Nonce: request.Nonce, PID: 101, ParentPID: request.ParentPID, Executable: request.Executable, ExecutableSHA256: request.ExecutableSHA256, Token: token, Native: native}
	output, err := json.Marshal(child)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	input, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	return &earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt{Stdout: output, Nonce: request.Nonce, Root: request.Root, Executable: request.Executable, ExecutableSHA256: request.ExecutableSHA256, ParentPID: 100, PID: 101, ParentToken: token, ChildToken: token, Started: at, Exited: at.Add(time.Millisecond), WaitReturned: at.Add(time.Millisecond), ExitConfirmed: true, ExitCode: 0, Outcome: "bootstrap_complete", InputBytes: len(input), OutputBytes: len(output), OutputComplete: true, Native: &native}
}

func earlyQFidTestFixture() ([]earlyWireRecord, []preciseIdentityRecord, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, earlyBootstrapState, parentInvalidationReport) {
	records, originalIdentity, unc, volume, markers, watcher := earlyTestFixture()
	serial := originalIdentity[1].QFid.VolumeID
	_, _, report := precisePolicyFixture()
	report.FirstObservationSequence = markers.FirstNewBegin
	report.Pending = &watcher
	identities := make([]preciseIdentityRecord, 0, 10)
	parentWire := make([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, 0, 10)
	for _, record := range records {
		if record.Command != wire.Create {
			continue
		}
		requested := record.Message != 23
		identity := preciseIdentityRecord{Sequence: record.Sequence, Connection: record.Connection, Session: record.Session, RawSession: record.RawSession, MessageID: record.Message, Command: wire.Create, Response: record.Response, Status: record.Status, FileID: record.FileID, ContextsChecked: true, QFidRequested: requested, Complete: true}
		if requested || record.Response {
			identity.ContextNames = []string{"51466964"}
		}
		if record.Response {
			disk := uint64(1)
			if record.Name == "v" {
				disk = 2
			}
			if record.Message == 18 {
				disk = 3
			}
			if record.Message == 23 {
				disk = 4
			}
			preciseSetQFidTuple(&identity, disk, serial)
		}
		identities = append(identities, identity)
		parentWire = append(parentWire, cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: record.Connection, SessionID: record.Session, MessageID: record.Message, Command: wire.Create, Response: record.Response, Status: record.Status, FileID: record.FileID, Name: record.Name})
	}
	state := earlyBootstrapState{UNC: unc, Volume: volume, Markers: markers, Process: earlyQFidTestProcess(unc)}
	return records, identities, parentWire, state, report
}

func TestEarlyQFidInteractionPositive(t *testing.T) {
	records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
	result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, nil)
	if !result.Exposed || !result.Early.Exposed || !result.QFid.StimulusDelivered || result.Outcome != "joint_exposure" || result.ProcessError != "" || result.SourceError != "" || result.Early.HA.FileID != result.QFid.OldResponse.FileID || result.Early.Hnew.FileID != result.QFid.NewResponse.FileID {
		t.Fatal("complete early/QFid interaction rejected", result)
	}
	if report.NewIdentity.Identity == result.QFid.NewResponse.QFid.DiskID {
		t.Fatal("fixture failed to keep native identity opaque")
	}
}

func TestEarlyQFidInteractionRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*[]earlyWireRecord, *[]preciseIdentityRecord, *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, *earlyBootstrapState, *parentInvalidationReport)
	}{
		{"missing early half", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*r)[11].Attributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(preciseTestFilesystemData(6))
		}},
		{"missing QFid half", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*i)[9].QFid = nil
			(*i)[9].ContextNames = nil
		}},
		{"late early response", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, s *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			s.Markers.Settled = 13
		}},
		{"wrong helper tree", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*r)[11].Tree = 8
		}},
		{"wrong helper session", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*r)[11].Session = 3
		}},
		{"requested new QFid", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*i)[8].QFidRequested = true
			(*i)[8].ContextNames = []string{"51466964"}
			(*i)[9].QFidRequested = true
		}},
		{"wrong actual B", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			preciseSetQFidTuple(&(*i)[9], 99, (*i)[9].QFid.VolumeID)
		}},
		{"wrong actual volume", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			preciseSetQFidTuple(&(*i)[9], 4, (*i)[9].QFid.VolumeID+1)
		}},
		{"malformed QFid", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*i)[9].QFid.Raw = "bad"
		}},
		{"new response after API end", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*i)[9].Sequence = 26
		}},
		{"early new response after API end", func(r *[]earlyWireRecord, _ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			(*r)[18].Sequence = 26
		}},
		{"missing new response", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			*i = (*i)[:9]
		}},
		{"duplicate new response", func(_ *[]earlyWireRecord, i *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *earlyBootstrapState, _ *parentInvalidationReport) {
			copy := (*i)[9]
			copy.Sequence = 27
			*i = append(*i, copy)
		}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
			tc.change(&records, &identities, &parentWire, &state, &report)
			result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, nil)
			if result.Exposed || result.Reason == "" || result.NativeOracle != report.IdentityResult {
				t.Fatal("incomplete interaction admitted or native verdict erased", result)
			}
			if tc.name == "missing early half" && !result.QFid.StimulusDelivered {
				t.Fatal("missing early half erased a true QFid fact", result)
			}
			if tc.name == "missing QFid half" && !result.Early.Exposed {
				t.Fatal("missing QFid half erased a true early fact", result)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, which := range []string{"HA", "Hnew"} {
		t.Run("different "+which+" correlation", func(t *testing.T) {
			records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
			index, wireIndex := 7, 7
			if which == "Hnew" {
				index = 9
				wireIndex = 9
			}
			identities[index].FileID = "other-" + which
			parentWire[wireIndex].FileID = identities[index].FileID
			result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, nil)
			if result.Exposed || result.Reason == "" {
				t.Fatal("different server-open ownership joined", result)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("raw source failure remains separate", func(t *testing.T) {
		records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
		report.IdentityResult = "replacement_identity_aliased"
		result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, errors.New("observer lost a frame"))
		if result.Exposed || result.Early.Exposed || result.QFid.StimulusDelivered || result.SourceError != "observer lost a frame" || result.ProcessError != "" || result.NativeOracle != report.IdentityResult {
			t.Fatal("source failure was hidden or native result replaced", result)
		}
	})
	t.Run("actual failed CREATE with source error stays raw", func(t *testing.T) {
		records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
		records[18].Status = 0xc0000034
		records[18].FileID = ""
		identities[9].Status = 0xc0000034
		identities[9].FileID = ""
		identities[9].QFid = nil
		identities[9].ContextNames = nil
		identities[9].ContextsChecked = false
		parentWire[9].Status = 0xc0000034
		parentWire[9].FileID = ""
		report.Qualification.Native.Error = "CreateFile failed"
		report.IdentityResult = "replacement_first_open_failed"
		for _, sourceErr := range []error{nil, errors.New("source incomplete")} {
			result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, sourceErr)
			if result.Exposed || result.QFid.WireSuccess || result.QFid.NativeOpenSucceeded || result.QFid.NewResponse == nil || result.QFid.NewResponse.Status != 0xc0000034 || result.QFid.NewResponse.QFid != nil || result.QFid.NewResponse.FileID != "" || result.NativeOracle != report.IdentityResult {
				t.Fatal("real CREATE failure acquired synthetic success", result)
			}
			if sourceErr != nil && result.SourceError == "" {
				t.Fatal("source guard failure hidden", result)
			}
		}
	})
}

func TestEarlyQFidInteractionProcessRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*earlyBootstrapState)
	}{
		{"missing receipt", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process = nil }},
		{"unconfirmed exit", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.ExitConfirmed = false }},
		{"failed exit", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.ExitCode = 3 }},
		{"forced exit", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.KillRequested = true }},
		{"retained owner", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.OwnerRetained = true }},
		{"wait error", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.WaitError = "unconfirmed wait" }},
		{"late helper exit", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) {
			s.Process.Exited = s.Process.Started.Add(11 * time.Second)
			s.Process.WaitReturned = s.Process.Exited
		}},
		{"missing native result", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.Native = nil }},
		{"foreign token", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.ParentToken.AuthenticationID++ }},
		{"foreign token session", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.ChildToken.SessionID++ }},
		{"wrong nonce", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.Nonce = hex.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xee}, 32)) }},
		{"wrong child PID", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.PID++ }},
		{"wrong root", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.Root += `target` }},
		{"incomplete output", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.OutputComplete = false }},
		{"stderr failure", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) {
			s.Process.Stderr = []byte("helper error")
			s.Process.OutputBytes += len(s.Process.Stderr)
		}},
		{"raw receipt malformed", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.Stdout = []byte("bad"); s.Process.OutputBytes = 3 }},
		{"native pending", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Process.Native.Pending = true; s.Process.Native.PinsRetained = true }},
		{"root close failed", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) {
			s.Process.Native.RootClosed = false
			s.Process.Native.CloseError = "close failed"
		}},
		{"source bootstrap error", func(s *earlyBootstrapState) { s.Error = "bootstrap cleanup unsettled" }},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
			tc.change(&state)
			result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, nil)
			if result.Exposed || result.ProcessError == "" || result.SourceError != "" || result.Outcome != "process_failed" || result.NativeOracle != report.IdentityResult {
				t.Fatal("helper failure lost its ownership", result)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEarlyQFidInteractionNativeOracle(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"distinct handles", "both old identity", "both new identity", "native identity API failure", "wrong B bytes"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, identities, parentWire, state, report := earlyQFidTestFixture()
			before, after := make([]byte, 257), make([]byte, 769)
			report.RetainedRead = cacheGatePositiveValue{Count: 257, Digest: cacheGatePositiveDigest(before)}
			report.NewRead = cacheGatePositiveValue{Count: 769, Digest: cacheGatePositiveDigest(after)}
			expected := "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes"
			switch mode {
			case "both old identity":
				report.NewIdentity.Identity = report.OldIdentity.Identity
				expected = "replacement_identity_aliased"
			case "both new identity":
				report.RetainedIdentity.Identity = report.NewIdentity.Identity
				expected = "retained_identity_changed"
			case "native identity API failure":
				report.NewIdentity.Error = "GetFileInformationByHandle failed"
				expected = "identity_unavailable"
			case "wrong B bytes":
				report.NewRead.Digest = "wrong"
				expected = "replacement_bytes_wrong"
			}
			report.IdentityResult = parentRelativeIdentity(report.OldIdentity, report.NewIdentity, report.RetainedIdentity, report.RetainedRead, report.NewRead, before, after)
			result := earlyQFidInteractionGate(records, identities, parentWire, state, &report, nil)
			if !result.Exposed || result.NativeOracle != expected || report.IdentityResult != expected {
				t.Fatal("joint exposure erased or replaced the original native verdict", mode, result)
			}
			if mode != "distinct handles" && result.NativeOracle == "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes" {
				t.Fatal("native failure became a mechanism pass")
			}
		})
	}
}
